Board Workplan
To facilitate effective delivery of the Board’s mandate and compliance with legal and regulatory
requirements, the Board is guided by an Annual Workplan detailing the activities of the Board for the
year. The Annual Workplan sets out the scheduled activities of the Board and Committees, together
with other activities including annual general meetings. The Workplan sets out the dates for Board
and Committee meetings, AGMs, investor briefings, dates for training and focus areas, among other
details.
